No published approach or ascent account of Rimrock Ridge exists that could be reached, let alone two. The stored leg (bushwhack east from Swamp Creek Camp) still leads away from the peak, but no sourced replacement exists and removing it would leave no approach; left for a person with a map. No ops.

The row (name 'E/SE Face') still blends two lines. (a) A route database's only Witches Tower route, 'East Face': 4th class, 300 ft, 'a series of zig-zagging ledges generally on the E/SE side of the tower', a short 4th-class hand-crack variation, 'Reverse the route to descend' — this is what grade, rock_grade, beta, pitch_detail, detailed_rack, bail, descent and the summit waypoint describe, and is the line the row's name ('E/SE') comes from. (b) A peak page (read via an archived copy, 2024-10-14): 'Southeast Face goes up the white rock one pitch 5.6' — this is what itinerary (note, schedule 2:30 PM item, objective, cal, totalNote), descent_text and rope/rappel text describe. A regional outdoors site only links to that peak page; the peak encyclopedia gives only the tower's easiest grade; a 2006 scramble report climbed an exposed slabby ledge on the SSE side then 3rd class — that matches the South Face scramble (whose club page also goes 'toward the white wall ... ledge ... around to the east side'), not either line here. Cascade forum threads return 401/Loading and have no archive. So each line still has exactly ONE source, and nothing states whether they are the same line (4th-class ledges vs a 5.6 white-rock pitch argue two lines). No change with two sources is possible. Recommendation (no ops): split into 'East Face' (4th class, ledges, reverse to descend) and 'Southeast Face' (one pitch 5.6 up the white rock, descend the south side), or keep this row as the East Face and strip the 5.6 itinerary/descent_text/rope content once a second source for either line appears.
